caption: Two keyframes hold the ends of the ball tween and every frame between them is computed. The text layer holds text broken apart into shapes, and it runs on its own shorter span, again bounded by two keyframes.

spec.aria: A timeline with a ball layer holding keyframes at frames 1 and 24 with a motion tween between them, and a text layer, holding text broken apart into shapes, with keyframes at frames 1 and 12 and a shape tween between them.
